text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif

svg.text: use Maximum Inner Product Search (MIPS) to find the top-K documents z_i.

text.font-family: 'Times New Roman', 'Noto Serif CJK SC', serif
